# CDT

Source: https://github.com/artem-ogre/CDT

Revision: `15c15405329e50303481df8f33e1bb6764e30f74`.

The headers in `CDT/include` are vendored unchanged for constrained Delaunay
triangulation. CDT uses robust orientation and in-circle predicates. The editor
uses its intersection resolution and retains the complete triangulated domain.
